## OFFLINE synthetic onboarding review
Ten invented fixture cases exercise all four routes. No API call, credentials, or real subjects. This is a local demonstration, not live screening. Open the four final nodes to inspect the records. All decisions remain **not_made**.

The separate sandbox workflow uses n8n-nodes-sanctionskit@0.1.0 and requires your own sandbox credential. Sandbox is free and synthetic; production screening is paid.
